انفرطت (form VII)
# اِنْفَرَطْتُ (infaraṭtu) /in.fa.ratˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# اِنْفَرَطْتَ (infaraṭta) /in.fa.ratˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# اِنْفَرَطْتِ (infaraṭti) /in.fa.ratˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# اِنْفَرَطَتْ (infaraṭat) /in.fa.ra.tˤat/: third-pe
